system.description:
The mounted knight. Examples: the Knights of Holfast, steeped in mounted war and formal doctrine, and the Eltor Cavalry Guard, the lance-and-horse elite of the Eltor court.

  • Saddle-Born (1st): while you are mounted, your Challenge reaches 60ft and a foe need only see you, not hear you. Your mount has Advantage on saves against fear and against effects that would unseat you.
  • The Order's Name (1st): Advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks when invoking your order's name, and on checks to judge a horse's quality.
  • Lancer's Charge (5th): your Mounted Charge with a lance also pushes the target 10ft before its Prone save, and the save is made with Disadvantage.
  • Mounted Champion (10th): you and your mount fight as one: it uses your AC and your saves when they are better than its own.
  • Once per round, your Ride-By lets you attack a second creature you pass, an exception to the one attack a charge allows (see Mounted Combat in The Arneyan Codex), with no Disadvantage.
  • A lance doubles its dice on only one of the two hits.
